setup: Drive the server over stdio and force an error/exception during capture (e.g. an unreadable record).
action: Trigger the error path while capturing stdout and stderr separately.
expected: Diagnostics/stack traces go to stderr; stdout stays frame-pure.
pass: 1.0 only if stdout remains 100% MCP frames during the error. Any diagnostic on stdout == 0.0 (hard cull).

setup: Include/simulate a dependency that logs to stdout on init.
action: Start the server over stdio and capture stdout at process init.
expected: No dependency banner/log reaches stdout; either suppressed or redirected to stderr.
pass: 1.0 only if stdout at init is 100% MCP frames (or empty until first frame). Any dependency stdout output == 0.0 (hard cull).

setup: Set a verbose/debug env flag the variant recognizes.
action: Run a full stdio session with debug/verbose enabled; capture stdout.
expected: Verbose diagnostics go to stderr only; stdout stays frame-pure regardless of debug flags.
pass: 1.0 only if stdout stays 100% MCP frames with debug on. Any debug output on stdout == 0.0 (hard cull).
